mechanism: Foscarnet can cause nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities that may impair finasteride clearance and increase exposure, while finasteride's effects on renal hemodynamics may exacerbate foscarnet-induced renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy, and assess finasteride efficacy and tolerability; consider dose adjustment if significant renal impairment develops.
